name: ci

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  # mise cannot lock Rust, so `mise install --locked` must skip it. Jobs that need Rust install it with rustup (see rust-toolchain.toml).
  MISE_DISABLE_TOOLS: rust

jobs:
  checks:
    name: Checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - name: Lint the workflows
        run: mise x -- actionlint
      - name: Evaluate every pkl module
        run: |
          for f in pkl/*.pkl; do
            mise x -- pkl eval "$f" > /dev/null
          done
      - name: Build the package
        run: mise x -- pkl project package pkl --output-path "$RUNNER_TEMP/package"
      - name: Run the runner tests
        working-directory: runner
        run: mise x -- bun test
      - name: Lint the consumer check sample
        run: mise x -- actionlint runner/test/fixtures/consumer-check.yml
      # rustup is preinstalled on GitHub-hosted runners. The version must match rust-toolchain.toml.
      - name: Install the Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.96.1 --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy
          rustup default 1.96.1
      - name: Check the Rust formatting
        run: cargo fmt --all --check
      - name: Lint the Rust code
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
      - name: Run the Rust unit tests
        run: mise x -- cargo test -p scaffold-core --locked
      - name: Check the Rust dependencies (licences, advisories, sources)
        run: mise x -- cargo-deny check

  # Mutation testing takes about ten minutes, so it runs beside the other checks and not inside them.
  mutation:
    name: Mutation tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - name: Install the Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.96.1 --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy
          rustup default 1.96.1
      # mise has no macOS arm64 build of cargo-mutants, so it is built from source at a pinned version.
      - name: Install cargo-mutants
        run: cargo install cargo-mutants --version 27.1.0 --locked
      - name: Mutation-test the Rust core
        run: mise x -- cargo mutants --package scaffold-core --jobs 2

  build:
    name: Build the binaries
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      BUILD_VERSION: 0.0.1-ci.${{ github.run_number }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - name: Build the runner for the three targets
        run: mise x -- bun runner/scripts/build.ts --version "$BUILD_VERSION" --out dist
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: binaries
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

  smoke:
    name: Smoke test ${{ matrix.target }}
    needs: build
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, target: linux-x64 }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04-arm, target: linux-arm64 }
          - { os: macos-latest, target: darwin-arm64 }
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      BUILD_VERSION: 0.0.1-ci.${{ github.run_number }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: binaries
          path: dist/
      - name: Make the binary executable
        run: chmod +x "dist/pantheon-scaffold-${{ matrix.target }}"
      - name: Run the smoke suite against the built binary
        run: mise x -- bun runner/scripts/smoke.ts "dist/pantheon-scaffold-${{ matrix.target }}" --version "$BUILD_VERSION"

  features:
    name: Features ${{ matrix.target }}
    needs: build
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, target: linux-x64 }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04-arm, target: linux-arm64 }
          - { os: macos-latest, target: darwin-arm64 }
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      SCAFFOLD_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/dist/pantheon-scaffold-${{ matrix.target }}
      SCAFFOLD_VERSION: 0.0.1-ci.${{ github.run_number }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      # rustup is preinstalled on GitHub-hosted runners. The version must match rust-toolchain.toml.
      - name: Install the Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.96.1 --profile minimal
          rustup default 1.96.1
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: binaries
          path: dist/
      - name: Make the binary executable
        run: chmod +x "$SCAFFOLD_BIN"
      - name: Run the features against the built binary
        run: mise x -- cargo test -p scaffold-features --locked

name: promote

# Promotes a published pre-release to a stable release (decisions 46, 56, 60, 90 and 91). By hand only, from main.
# The first job runs every guard and edits nothing: it is the whole of a dry run, and it never touches the environment.
# The second job is the only one that can edit a release. It names the environment "promote", runs every guard again,
# removes the pre-release flag, and checks that the assets and checksums.txt did not change. The environment has no
# protection rules while the repository has one contributor (decision 91), so it records the run and does not gate it:
# see "Before onboarding a contributor" in docs/release-process.md.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: The release tag to promote, for example v0.1.5
        type: string
        required: true
      dry_run:
        description: Run every guard and edit nothing
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: promote
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # mise cannot lock Rust, so `mise install --locked` must skip it. Jobs that need Rust install it with rustup (see rust-toolchain.toml).
  MISE_DISABLE_TOOLS: rust

jobs:
  guards:
    name: Check every guard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - name: Run every guard, edit nothing
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          GITHUB_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
        run: mise x -- bun runner/scripts/promote.ts check "$TAG"

  promote:
    name: Promote the release
    needs: guards
    if: inputs.dry_run == false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    environment: promote
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - name: Run every guard again, remove the pre-release flag, and check the result
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          GITHUB_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          TAG: ${{ inputs.tag }}
        run: mise x -- bun runner/scripts/promote.ts promote "$TAG"

name: release

# A v-tag push publishes a pre-release of the package and the runner binaries, together, under the version in pkl/PklProject.
# Run by hand it is a dry run: everything is built, tested and assembled, and nothing is attested or published.
on:
  push:
    tags: ["v[0-9]*"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: Build and assemble everything but attest and publish nothing
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # mise cannot lock Rust, so `mise install --locked` must skip it. Jobs that need Rust install it with rustup (see rust-toolchain.toml).
  MISE_DISABLE_TOOLS: rust

jobs:
  prepare:
    name: Check the version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - name: Check the tag against pkl/PklProject, or read the version for a dry run
        id: version
        env:
          REF_TYPE: ${{ github.ref_type }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          if [ "$REF_TYPE" = tag ]; then
            version="$(mise x -- bun runner/scripts/release-assets.ts check-tag "$REF_NAME")"
          else
            version="$(mise x -- bun runner/scripts/release-assets.ts version)"
          fi
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Refuse to release a version that already has a release
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          if gh release view "$REF_NAME" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "A release for $REF_NAME already exists. A published version is never re-published: use a new patch version." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

  build:
    name: Test and build
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - name: Run the runner tests
        working-directory: runner
        run: mise x -- bun test
      - name: Build the package
        run: mise x -- pkl project package pkl --output-path dist
      - name: Build the runner for the three targets
        run: mise x -- bun runner/scripts/build.ts --version "$VERSION" --out dist
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: built-files
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

  smoke:
    name: Smoke test ${{ matrix.target }}
    needs: [prepare, build]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, target: linux-x64 }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04-arm, target: linux-arm64 }
          - { os: macos-latest, target: darwin-arm64 }
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: built-files
          path: dist/
      - name: Make the binary executable
        run: chmod +x "dist/pantheon-scaffold-${{ matrix.target }}"
      - name: Run the smoke suite against the built binary
        run: mise x -- bun runner/scripts/smoke.ts "dist/pantheon-scaffold-${{ matrix.target }}" --version "$VERSION"

  release:
    name: Attest and publish
    needs: [prepare, smoke]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: built-files
          path: dist/
      - name: Write checksums.txt after cross-checking the package files
        run: |
          rm -f dist/checksums.txt
          mise x -- bun runner/scripts/release-assets.ts checksums dist "$VERSION"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-assets
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error
      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        with:
          subject-path: |
            dist/pantheon-scaffold-*
            dist/pantheon-scaffold@*
            dist/checksums.txt
      - name: Publish the pre-release
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          gh release create "$TAG" dist/* \
            --verify-tag \
            --prerelease \
            --title "$TAG (pre-release)" \
            --notes "Pre-release of the package and the runner, released together. checksums.txt lists every file and carries a build provenance attestation: gh attestation verify checksums.txt --repo $GH_REPO"

  verify-release:
    name: Verify the published release on ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: [prepare, release]
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-latest]
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
      TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
      REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
    steps:
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the runner as a consumer would, with checksums and provenance enforced
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer" && cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer"
          cat > mise.toml <<TOML
          [settings]
          lockfile = true
          locked_verify_provenance = true
          lockfile_platforms = ["linux-x64", "linux-arm64", "macos-arm64"]

          [tools]
          pkl = "0.32.2"
          "github:$REPO" = "$VERSION"
          TOML
          mise lock
          # With no platform list mise locks every platform and picks the package zip for the ones with no runner, so the lock is checked.
          urls="$(grep -A6 "^\[tools\.\"github:$REPO\"\.\"platforms\." mise.lock | grep '^url = ' || true)"
          echo "$urls"
          test "$(echo "$urls" | grep -c .)" = 3
          if echo "$urls" | grep -vE '/pantheon-scaffold-(linux-x64|linux-arm64|darwin-arm64)"$'; then
            echo "mise chose an asset that is not a runner binary" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          mise install --locked
          test "$(mise x -- pantheon-scaffold --version)" = "$VERSION"
      - name: Verify the attestation of checksums.txt, as upgrade does
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer"
          curl -fsSL --retry 8 --retry-delay 10 --retry-all-errors -o checksums.txt "https://github.com/$REPO/releases/download/$TAG/checksums.txt"
          gh attestation verify checksums.txt --repo "$REPO"
      - name: Load the package from its package URI with the published checksum
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer"
          sum="$(awk -v n="pantheon-scaffold@$VERSION" '$2 == n { print $1 }' checksums.txt)"
          test -n "$sum"
          printf 'amends "package://github.com/%s/releases/download/%s/pantheon-scaffold@%s::sha256:%s#/Config.pkl"\n\noptions { toolchain = "1.96.1" }\n' "$REPO" "$TAG" "$VERSION" "$sum" > pantheon.pkl
          mise x -- pantheon-scaffold render pantheon.pkl --attempts 8
          mise x -- pantheon-scaffold check pantheon.pkl --attempts 8

name: update-pins

# Weekly, and when this workflow or its script changes: moves the pinned actions in pkl/Pins.pkl to their latest published release (one pull request),
# then records the date of the last successful check on the `freshness` branch. A failed check writes neither, so a failing check never reads as fresh.
# Writes use the pantheon-ai-bot App token (contents and pull-requests write), so the pull request starts the required checks.
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "23 4 * * 1"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/update-pins.yml
      - runner/scripts/update-pins.ts
      - runner/src/pinupdate.ts
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: update-pins
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # mise cannot lock Rust, so `mise install --locked` must skip it. Jobs that need Rust install it with rustup (see rust-toolchain.toml).
  MISE_DISABLE_TOOLS: rust

jobs:
  update:
    name: Update the pins
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Mint pantheon-ai-bot token
        id: app-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510 # v3.3.0
        with:
          client-id: Iv23ligzn16vkDCWfHgc
          private-key: ${{ secrets.GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          permission-contents: write
          permission-pull-requests: write
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - name: Check every pin and rewrite the ones that moved
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
        run: |
          mise x -- bun runner/scripts/update-pins.ts \
            --freshness-out "$RUNNER_TEMP/freshness.json" --summary "$RUNNER_TEMP/summary.md"
      - name: Open or update the pin pull request
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          if git diff --quiet pkl/Pins.pkl; then echo "No pin changed."; exit 0; fi
          branch="chore/update-pins"
          git switch -c "$branch"
          git add pkl/Pins.pkl
          git -c user.name="pantheon-ai-bot[bot]" -c user.email="pantheon-ai-bot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com" \
            commit --message "chore(deps): update pinned actions"
          git push --force "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${REPO}.git" "$branch"
          if [ -z "$(gh pr list --repo "$REPO" --head "$branch" --json number --jq '.[].number')" ]; then
            gh pr create --repo "$REPO" --head "$branch" --title "chore(deps): update pinned actions" --body-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/summary.md"
          fi
      - name: Record the successful check on the freshness branch
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          git switch --orphan freshness-record
          cp "$RUNNER_TEMP/freshness.json" freshness.json
          git add freshness.json
          git -c user.name="pantheon-ai-bot[bot]" -c user.email="pantheon-ai-bot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com" \
            commit --message "chore: record the pin check"
          git push --force "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${REPO}.git" HEAD:refs/heads/freshness

# Keeps Cargo dependencies and the SHA-pinned GitHub Actions current. Minor and
# patch bumps are grouped into one weekly PR per ecosystem to cut review noise;
# major bumps are raised individually so breaking changes are reviewed alone.
# Ported from pantheon-org/tekhne.
#
# Cargo caveat: pahdk-core and pahdk-install are git dependencies pinned by tag in
# Cargo.toml. Dependabot cannot resolve them (dependency_file_not_resolvable), and
# that error fails the whole cargo job, so they are ignored below. Bump the tag by
# hand when pantheon-agentic-harness-dev-kit cuts a release.
#
# release.yml caveat: release.yml is written by `dist generate` from dist-workspace.toml, which
# Dependabot cannot edit, so a Dependabot bump of upload-artifact or download-artifact inside
# it would fail the dist check. They are ignored below: change their commits in
# dist-workspace.toml and run `dist generate`.
version: 2
updates:
- package-ecosystem: cargo
  directory: /
  schedule:
    interval: weekly
    day: monday
  open-pull-requests-limit: 5
  cooldown:
    default-days: 7
  ignore:
  - dependency-name: pahdk-core
  - dependency-name: pahdk-install
  labels:
  - dependencies
  - rust
  commit-message:
    prefix: chore
    prefix-development: chore
    include: scope
  groups:
    cargo-minor-patch:
      patterns:
      - '*'
      update-types:
      - minor
      - patch
- package-ecosystem: github-actions
  directory: /
  schedule:
    interval: weekly
    day: monday
  open-pull-requests-limit: 5
  cooldown:
    default-days: 7
  ignore:
  - dependency-name: actions/upload-artifact
  - dependency-name: actions/download-artifact
  labels:
  - dependencies
  - github-actions
  commit-message:
    prefix: ci
    include: scope
  groups:
    actions-minor-patch:
      patterns:
      - '*'
      update-types:
      - minor
      - patch

# Lints the bundled skill with agnix (https://github.com/agent-sh/agnix) against
# Claude Code's documented formats: frontmatter fields and values, allowed-tools
# names, broken links and leaked tool-call markup. The skill validator and auditor
# do not check these.
#
# Runs on every pull request and every push to main. A pull request fails only on
# an error it introduces, meaning an error whose rule and file are not already an
# error on the base branch (.github/scripts/agnix-introduced-errors.sh). Errors
# already on main and warnings show as annotations and never fail. Configuration
# lives in .agnix.toml. Never runs --fix.
#
# Ported from pantheon-org/tekhne. Issues: one per error (rule and file) and one per
# warning rule listing every affected file (.github/scripts/agnix-file-issues.sh). A
# pull request opens a missing issue but never edits or closes one; the run on main
# opens missing issues, refreshes warning file lists and closes issues whose finding
# is gone. One "## agnix" pull request comment shows PASS or FAIL and is updated in
# place on each run.
#
# No third-party action for agnix itself: the pinned release is downloaded from its
# public URL and checked against a pinned SHA-256 before it runs. The digest was
# taken from a tarball whose GitHub build attestation verified against agnix's
# release.yml.
name: agnix
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - synchronize
    - reopened
    branches:
    - main
  push:
    branches:
    - main
permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
env:
  AGNIX_VERSION: 0.56.6
  AGNIX_SHA256: 3228e88286c44da93bd591cc6358549c4a3d685b44c9d64625955d668528a155
jobs:
  agnix:
    name: agnix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork == false
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Check out the base branch
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      with:
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        path: base
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Install agnix (pinned digest)
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        asset="agnix-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"
        dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/agnix"
        mkdir -p "$dir"
        curl -fsSL -o "$dir/$asset" \
          "https://github.com/agent-sh/agnix/releases/download/v${AGNIX_VERSION}/${asset}"
        echo "${AGNIX_SHA256}  $dir/$asset" | sha256sum -c -
        tar -xzf "$dir/$asset" -C "$dir"
        echo "$dir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
    - name: Lint
      run: |
        agnix --version
        agnix -c .agnix.toml --format github . || true
        agnix -c .agnix.toml --format json . > agnix.json || true
    - name: Lint the base branch
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      run: |
        (cd base && agnix -c ../.agnix.toml --format json . > ../agnix-base.json) || true
    - name: File issues for findings
      continue-on-error: true
      run: bash .github/scripts/agnix-file-issues.sh agnix.json
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        MODE: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && 'main' || 'pr' }}
        PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        TRACKED_FILE: tracked-issues.md
    - name: Find errors this pull request introduces
      id: gate
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      continue-on-error: true
      run: bash .github/scripts/agnix-introduced-errors.sh agnix.json agnix-base.json
      env:
        INTRODUCED_FILE: introduced-errors.txt
    - name: Assemble comment
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      run: bash .github/scripts/agnix-assemble-comment.sh
    - name: Find existing agnix comment
      id: find-comment
      uses: peter-evans/find-comment@b30e6a3c0ed37e7c023ccd3f1db5c6c0b0c23aad
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      continue-on-error: true
      with:
        issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        comment-author: github-actions[bot]
        body-includes: '## agnix'
    - name: Post or update agnix comment
      uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@e8674b075228eee787fea43ef493e45ece1004c9
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      continue-on-error: true
      with:
        comment-id: ${{ steps.find-comment.outputs.comment-id }}
        issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        edit-mode: replace
        body-path: comment.md
    - name: Fail on introduced errors
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.gate.outcome == 'failure'
      run: |
        echo "::error::This pull request introduces agnix errors; see the agnix comment."
        exit 1

steps.name: Install agnix (pinned digest)
steps.run:

# the allowed commit types inside its regex, because it runs on

    - .github/scripts/check-commit-types.sh

    - main

    - .github/workflows/conventional-commits.yml
    - .github/workflows/commit-types.yml
    - .github/scripts/check-commit-types.sh

docs.text:
# Pull requests are squash-merged, so the title becomes the commit message on
# main and is what release-please parses to pick the version bump and write
# the changelog. A malformed title produces a wrong bump or no release at all,
# silently.
#
# The allowed types are copied into the regex below from .github/commit-types.txt.
# The copy is deliberate: this runs on pull_request_target, where the workflow
# has a privileged token, so it checks out nothing and reads only the event
# payload. .github/scripts/check-commit-types.sh fails if the copy drifts, and
# the Commit Types workflow runs that check on pull requests.
name: Conventional Commit Title
'on': # zizmor: ignore[dangerous-triggers] reads only the PR title; checks out and runs no PR code
  pull_request_target:
    types:
    - opened
    - edited
    - reopened
    - synchronize
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  title:
    name: Conventional Commit Title
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
    - name: Check the pull request title
      run: |
        pattern='^(build|chore|ci|docs|feat|fix|perf|refactor|revert|style|test)(\([[:alnum:]][[:alnum:]./_-]*\))?!?: [[:lower:]](.*[[:graph:]])?$'
        if [[ ! "$PR_TITLE" =~ $pattern ]]; then
          echo "::error title=Invalid pull request title::The title does not match the required format."
          printf 'Received title: %q\n' "$PR_TITLE"
          echo "Use: <type>[optional scope][optional !]: <summary starting lowercase>"
          echo "Types: build chore ci docs feat fix perf refactor revert style test"
          exit 1
        fi
      env:
        PR_TITLE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}

steps.name: Check the pull request title
steps.run:
pattern='^(build|chore|ci|docs|feat|fix|perf|refactor|revert|style|test)(\([[:alnum:]][[:alnum:]./_-]*\))?!?: [[:lower:]](.*[[:graph:]])?$'
if [[ ! "$PR_TITLE" =~ $pattern ]]; then
  echo "::error title=Invalid pull request title::The title does not match the required format."
  printf 'Received title: %q\n' "$PR_TITLE"
  echo "Use: <type>[optional scope][optional !]: <summary starting lowercase>"

# CI/CD security scan of this repository's GitHub Actions workflows (unpinned
# actions, untrusted shell input, over-broad permissions). Findings surface in the
# Security tab (Code Scanning SARIF).
#
# Gating model (ported from pantheon-org/tekhne): Critical findings BLOCK the PR;
# everything else is visible in Code Scanning and never blocks. The Plumber action
# runs with soft-fail + continue-on-error so its own A-E score gate and any
# transient runtime error never block; the ONLY blocking signal is a Critical
# finding in the gate step below. Config lives in .plumber.yaml.
#
# Generated by pantheon-scaffold from pantheon.pkl: change it there, not in this file.
name: Plumber
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - synchronize
    - reopened
    branches:
    - main
  push:
    branches:
    - main
  schedule:
  - cron: 41 3 * * 1
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  plumber:
    name: Plumber Score
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      security-events: write
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - id: plumber
      uses: getplumber/plumber@ec8cb3a7edd6a324b33e85109b627b2df6023d94
      continue-on-error: true
      with:
        soft-fail: 'true'
        score-push: 'false'
        output: results.json
    - name: Gate on Critical findings
      run: |
        if [ ! -f results.json ]; then
          echo "::warning::results.json not found; Plumber did not produce a report (likely a transient scan error). Critical gate skipped this run."
          exit 0
        fi
        critical="$(jq '.plumberScore.counts.critical // 0' results.json)"
        if [ "$critical" -gt 0 ]; then
          echo "::error::${critical} Critical-severity Plumber finding(s) present; see the Code Scanning alerts for detail."
          jq -r '(.plumberScore.codeLosses // [])[] | select(.severity == "critical") | "::error::[\(.code)] \(.count) Critical-severity finding(s)"' results.json
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "No Critical-severity Plumber findings. Gate passed."

    - name: Mint pantheon-ai-bot token

# crates/adr/Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock, plus CHANGELOG.md, from conventional
# commits). Once that PR is merged, the same run tags the new version, and the tag
# starts release.yml (cargo-dist), which builds and publishes the GitHub Release.
# release-please is told not to create the GitHub Release itself, because cargo-dist
# creates it and fails if one exists. Ported from pantheon-org/tekhne.
#
# Uses the pantheon-ai-bot App token because pushes made with GITHUB_TOKEN do not
# trigger other workflows, so the tag would never start release.yml.
# Needs the org secret GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY.

'on':

    - main
  workflow_dispatch: {}
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: release-please
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  release-please:
    name: Update release PR and tag releases
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
    - name: Mint pantheon-ai-bot token
      id: app-token
      uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510
      with:
        client-id: Iv23ligzn16vkDCWfHgc
        private-key: ${{ secrets.GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        permission-contents: write
        permission-pull-requests: write
    - uses: googleapis/release-please-action@45996ed1f6d02564a971a2fa1b5860e934307cf7

docs.text:
# zizmor rule configuration for the zizmor workflow (.github/workflows/zizmor.yml).
#
# Every entry is a finding that existed when the gate was added and is
# deliberately not fixed. The default answer to a zizmor finding is to fix the
# workflow; an entry here needs a reason, and should be as narrow as the tool
# allows so it cannot hide anything else.
#
# All four entries are in .github/workflows/release.yml, which cargo-dist
# generates and overwrites on `dist generate`. Entries match on file, line and
# column, so a regenerated file that moves a line makes the finding reappear and
# fails the gate. When that happens, run the command in the workflow header,
# check the finding is still the same one, and update the line and column here.
# Do not edit release.yml by hand to avoid it: dist would undo the edit.

rules:
  excessive-permissions:
    ignore:
      # The workflow-level `contents: write` is what dist emits, so the release
      # job can create the GitHub release and upload artifacts. The workflow
      # runs only on a pushed version tag (pr-run-mode = "skip" in
      # dist-workspace.toml).
      - release.yml:18:3
  template-injection:
    ignore:
      # The `dist` plan step expands `github.ref_name` into its command. The
      # workflow runs only on a pushed version tag, and tags are created by
      # maintainers, not by a pull request.
      - release.yml:79:91
  unpinned-images:
    ignore:
      # The build matrix is produced by dist's plan job. The container image
      # comes from dist's own output, not from a pull request.
      - release.yml:110:40
      - release.yml:110:66

docs.text:
# Lints agent skills and agent config files with agnix (https://github.com/agent-sh/agnix) against
# Claude Code's documented formats: frontmatter fields and values, allowed-tools
# names, broken links and leaked tool-call markup. The skill validator and auditor
# do not check these.
#
# Runs on every pull request and every push to main. A pull request fails only on
# an error it introduces, meaning an error whose rule and file are not already an
# error on the base branch (.github/scripts/agnix-introduced-errors.sh). Errors
# already on main and warnings show as annotations and never fail. Configuration
# lives in .agnix.toml. Never runs --fix.
#
# Ported from pantheon-org/tekhne. Issues: one per error (rule and file) and one per
# warning rule listing every affected file (.github/scripts/agnix-file-issues.sh). A
# pull request opens a missing issue but never edits or closes one; the run on main
# opens missing issues, refreshes warning file lists and closes issues whose finding
# is gone. One "## agnix" pull request comment shows PASS or FAIL and is updated in
# place on each run.
#
# No third-party action for agnix itself: the pinned release is downloaded from its
# public URL and checked against a pinned SHA-256 before it runs. The digest was
# taken from a tarball whose GitHub build attestation verified against agnix's
# release.yml.
name: agnix
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - synchronize
    - reopened
    branches:
    - main
  push:
    branches:
    - main
permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
env:
  AGNIX_VERSION: 0.56.6
  AGNIX_SHA256: 3228e88286c44da93bd591cc6358549c4a3d685b44c9d64625955d668528a155
jobs:
  agnix:
    name: agnix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork == false
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Check out the base branch
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      with:
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        path: base
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Install agnix (pinned digest)
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        asset="agnix-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"
        dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/agnix"
        mkdir -p "$dir"
        curl -fsSL -o "$dir/$asset" \
          "https://github.com/agent-sh/agnix/releases/download/v${AGNIX_VERSION}/${asset}"
        echo "${AGNIX_SHA256}  $dir/$asset" | sha256sum -c -
        tar -xzf "$dir/$asset" -C "$dir"
        echo "$dir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
    - name: Lint
      run: |
        agnix --version
        agnix -c .agnix.toml --format github . || true
        agnix -c .agnix.toml --format json . > agnix.json || true
    - name: Lint the base branch
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      run: |
        (cd base && agnix -c ../.agnix.toml --format json . > ../agnix-base.json) || true
    - name: File issues for findings
      continue-on-error: true
      run: bash .github/scripts/agnix-file-issues.sh agnix.json
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        MODE: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && 'main' || 'pr' }}
        PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        TRACKED_FILE: tracked-issues.md
    - name: Find errors this pull request introduces
      id: gate
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      continue-on-error: true
      run: bash .github/scripts/agnix-introduced-errors.sh agnix.json agnix-base.json
      env:
        INTRODUCED_FILE: introduced-errors.txt
    - name: Assemble comment
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      run: bash .github/scripts/agnix-assemble-comment.sh
    - name: Find existing agnix comment
      id: find-comment
      uses: peter-evans/find-comment@b30e6a3c0ed37e7c023ccd3f1db5c6c0b0c23aad
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      continue-on-error: true
      with:
        issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        comment-author: github-actions[bot]
        body-includes: '## agnix'
    - name: Post or update agnix comment
      uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@e8674b075228eee787fea43ef493e45ece1004c9
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      continue-on-error: true
      with:
        comment-id: ${{ steps.find-comment.outputs.comment-id }}
        issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        edit-mode: replace
        body-path: comment.md
    - name: Fail on introduced errors
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.gate.outcome == 'failure'
      run: |
        echo "::error::This pull request introduces agnix errors; see the agnix comment."
        exit 1

steps.name: Install agnix (pinned digest)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
asset="agnix-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"
dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/agnix"
mkdir -p "$dir"
curl -fsSL -o "$dir/$asset" \
  "https://github.com/agent-sh/agnix/releases/download/v${AGNIX_VERSION}/${asset}"
echo "${AGNIX_SHA256}  $dir/$asset" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf "$dir/$asset" -C "$dir"
echo "$dir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Lint
steps.run:
agnix --version
agnix -c .agnix.toml --format github . || true
agnix -c .agnix.toml --format json . > agnix.json || true

steps.name: Find errors this pull request introduces
Fail on introduced errors
steps.run:
echo "::error::This pull request introduces agnix errors; see the agnix comment."
exit 1

    - main

  contents: read

  group: release-please
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  release-please:
    name: Update release PR and tag releases
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
    - name: Mint pantheon-ai-bot token
      id: app-token
      uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510
      with:
        client-id: Iv23ligzn16vkDCWfHgc
        private-key: ${{ secrets.GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        permission-contents: write
        permission-pull-requests: write
    - uses: googleapis/release-please-action@45996ed1f6d02564a971a2fa1b5860e934307cf7

# Static analysis for GitHub Actions security problems: credential persistence,
# template injection, over-broad permissions, unpinned actions. A finding at
# high severity fails the job.
#
# This runs beside Plumber rather than replacing it. Plumber reports without
# blocking; zizmor blocks, and covers credential persistence and template
# injection, which Plumber does not.
#
# No path filter, so the check always reports a conclusion: a required check
# that is skipped blocks the pull request forever. Also runs on push to main as
# a post-merge safety net.
#
# Scans .github (the workflows and dependabot.yml) and the repository's own
# composite action, action.yml. Not the whole repository: the action's default
# input is ".", which also reaches the skill fixtures under crates/ and skills/.
#
# Run it locally with the same findings (zizmor is pinned in mise.toml):
#   GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) mise exec -- zizmor --min-severity high \
#     --config .github/zizmor.yml .github action.yml
name: zizmor
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - synchronize
    - reopened
    branches:
    - main
  push:
    branches:
    - main
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  zizmor:
    name: zizmor
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

docs.text:
# zizmor rule configuration for the zizmor workflow (.github/workflows/zizmor.yml).
#
# Every entry is a finding that existed when the gate was added and is
# deliberately not fixed. The default answer to a zizmor finding is to fix the
# workflow; an entry here needs a reason, and should be as narrow as the tool
# allows so it cannot hide anything else.
#
# Four entries are in .github/workflows/release.yml, which cargo-dist generates
# and overwrites on `dist generate`. Entries match on file, line and column, so
# a regenerated file that moves a line makes the finding reappear and fails the
# gate. When that happens, run the command in the workflow header, check the
# finding is still the same one, and update the line and column here. Do not
# edit release.yml by hand to avoid it: dist would undo the edit. The fifth is
# in the repository's own action.yml.

rules:
  github-env:
    ignore:
      # action.yml writes the directory it installs the auditor into onto
      # GITHUB_PATH, so later steps can call `pantheon-skill-auditor` by name.
      # zizmor flags any write to that file. Here the value is a fixed directory
      # under RUNNER_TEMP, not input from a pull request, and the download is
      # verified against a SHA-256 first. Callers rely on the binary being on
      # PATH, so removing the write would break them. Pinned to the line and
      # column so a second write elsewhere in the file is still reported.
      - action.yml:35:7
  excessive-permissions:
    ignore:
      # The workflow-level `contents: write` is what dist emits, so the release
      # job can create the GitHub release and upload artifacts. The workflow
      # runs only on a pushed version tag (pr-run-mode = "skip" in
      # dist-workspace.toml).
      - release.yml:18:3
  template-injection:
    ignore:
      # The `dist` plan step expands `github.ref_name` into its command. The
      # workflow runs only on a pushed version tag, and tags are created by
      # maintainers, not by a pull request.
      - release.yml:79:91
  unpinned-images:
    ignore:
      # The build matrix is produced by dist's plan job. The container image
      # comes from dist's own output, not from a pull request.
      - release.yml:110:40
      - release.yml:110:66

# Weekly: proposes the latest pantheon-scaffold release as a pull request.
# Fails when the package's freshness record is older than 30 days, so a package
# whose pins are no longer checked is never proposed. Opens nothing when the
# repository already runs the latest release.
#
# Needs the org secret GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY and the App installed on this repository
# with contents, pull-requests and workflows write (workflows write is needed
# because an upgrade can change files under .github/workflows).
name: Upgrade pantheon-scaffold
'on':
  schedule:
  - cron: 17 5 * * 1
  workflow_dispatch: {}
permissions: {}
concurrency:
  group: upgrade-scaffold
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  upgrade:
    name: Propose the latest release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
    - name: Mint pantheon-ai-bot token
      id: app-token
      uses: actions/create-github-app-token@64ab729a6294000f5aa4a4bc0b73d1f32bc45510
      with:
        client-id: Iv23ligzn16vkDCWfHgc
        private-key: ${{ secrets.GH_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
        permission-contents: write
        permission-pull-requests: write
        permission-workflows: write
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Install the pinned tools
      uses: jdx/mise-action@b44d12e7d0d8ee7461bb893e1b1993500433185b
      with:
        install: true
    - name: Check the freshness record
      run: |
        mise x -- pantheon-scaffold freshness
    - name: Find the latest release
      id: latest
      run: |
        latest="$(mise x -- pantheon-scaffold latest)"
        current="$(mise x -- pantheon-scaffold --version)"
        echo "latest=${latest}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        if [ "$latest" = "$current" ]; then
          echo "Already on ${current}, nothing to propose."
          echo "needed=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        else
          echo "needed=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
        fi
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
    - name: Upgrade
      if: steps.latest.outputs.needed == 'true'
      run: |
        mise x -- pantheon-scaffold upgrade "$LATEST" --config pantheon.pkl
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
        LATEST: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.latest }}
    - name: Open the pull request
      if: steps.latest.outputs.needed == 'true'
      run: |
        branch="chore/upgrade-pantheon-scaffold-${LATEST}"
        git switch -c "$branch"
        git add --all
        git -c user.name="pantheon-ai-bot[bot]" -c user.email="pantheon-ai-bot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com" \
          commit --message "chore: upgrade pantheon-scaffold to ${LATEST}"
        git push "https://x-access-token:${GH_TOKEN}@github.com/${REPO}.git" "$branch"
        gh pr create --head "$branch" --title "chore: upgrade pantheon-scaffold to ${LATEST}" \
          --body "Moves the pinned runner and package to ${LATEST}, then renders. Review the diff before merging."
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
        LATEST: ${{ steps.latest.outputs.latest }}
        REPO: ${{ github.repository }}

steps.run:
latest="$(mise x -- pantheon-scaffold latest)"
current="$(mise x -- pantheon-scaffold --version)"

if [ "$latest" = "$current" ]; then

name: ci

  MISE_DISABLE_TOOLS: rust

  checks:
    name: Checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - name: Lint the workflows
        run: mise x -- actionlint
      - name: Evaluate every pkl module
        run: |
          for f in pkl/*.pkl; do
            mise x -- pkl eval "$f" > /dev/null
          done
      - name: Build the package
        run: mise x -- pkl project package pkl --output-path "$RUNNER_TEMP/package"
      - name: Run the runner tests
        working-directory: runner
        run: mise x -- bun test
      - name: Lint the consumer check sample
        run: mise x -- actionlint runner/test/fixtures/consumer-check.yml
      # rustup is preinstalled on GitHub-hosted runners. The version must match rust-toolchain.toml.
      - name: Install the Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.96.1 --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy
          rustup default 1.96.1
      - name: Check the Rust formatting
        run: cargo fmt --all --check
      - name: Lint the Rust code
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
      - name: Run the Rust unit tests
        run: mise x -- cargo test -p scaffold-core --locked
      - name: Check the Rust dependencies (licences, advisories, sources)
        run: mise x -- cargo-deny check

  # Mutation testing takes about ten minutes, so it runs beside the other checks and not inside them.
  mutation:
    name: Mutation tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - name: Install the Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.96.1 --profile minimal --component rustfmt,clippy
          rustup default 1.96.1
      # mise has no macOS arm64 build of cargo-mutants, so it is built from source at a pinned version.
      - name: Install cargo-mutants
        run: cargo install cargo-mutants --version 27.1.0 --locked
      - name: Mutation-test the Rust core
        run: mise x -- cargo mutants --package scaffold-core --jobs 2

  build:
    name: Build the binaries
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      BUILD_VERSION: 0.0.1-ci.${{ github.run_number }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked

        run: mise x -- bun runner/scripts/build.ts --version "$BUILD_VERSION" --out dist

        with:

          path: dist/
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

name: promote

# Promotes a published pre-release to a stable release (decisions 46, 56, 60, 90 and 91). By hand only, from main.
# The first job runs every guard and edits nothing: it is the whole of a dry run, and it never touches the environment.
# The second job is the only one that can edit a release. It names the environment "promote", runs every guard again,
# removes the pre-release flag, and checks that the assets and checksums.txt did not change. The environment has no
# protection rules while the repository has one contributor (decision 91), so it records the run and does not gate it:
# see "Before onboarding a contributor" in docs/release-process.md.
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      tag:
        description: The release tag to promote, for example v0.1.5
        type: string
        required: true
      dry_run:
        description: Run every guard and edit nothing
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: promote
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # mise cannot lock Rust, so `mise install --locked` must skip it. Jobs that need Rust install it with rustup (see rust-toolchain.toml).
  MISE_DISABLE_TOOLS: rust

jobs:
  guards:
    name: Check every guard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file

      - name: Run every guard, edit nothing
        env:

          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}

name: release

# A v-tag push publishes a pre-release of the package and the runner binaries, together, under the version in pkl/PklProject.
# Run by hand it is a dry run: everything is built, tested and assembled, and nothing is attested or published.
on:
  push:
    tags: ["v[0-9]*"]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: Build and assemble everything but attest and publish nothing
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  # mise cannot lock Rust, so `mise install --locked` must skip it. Jobs that need Rust install it with rustup (see rust-toolchain.toml).
  MISE_DISABLE_TOOLS: rust

jobs:
  prepare:
    name: Check the version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - name: Check the tag against pkl/PklProject, or read the version for a dry run
        id: version
        env:
          REF_TYPE: ${{ github.ref_type }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          if [ "$REF_TYPE" = tag ]; then
            version="$(mise x -- bun runner/scripts/release-assets.ts check-tag "$REF_NAME")"
          else
            version="$(mise x -- bun runner/scripts/release-assets.ts version)"
          fi
          echo "version=$version" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Refuse to release a version that already has a release
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          if gh release view "$REF_NAME" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "A release for $REF_NAME already exists. A published version is never re-published: use a new patch version." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

  build:
    name: Test and build
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - name: Run the runner tests
        working-directory: runner
        run: mise x -- bun test
      - name: Build the package
        run: mise x -- pkl project package pkl --output-path dist
      - name: Build the runner for the three targets
        run: mise x -- bun runner/scripts/build.ts --version "$VERSION" --out dist
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: built-files
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 1
          if-no-files-found: error

  smoke:
    name: Smoke test ${{ matrix.target }}
    needs: [prepare, build]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, target: linux-x64 }
          - { os: ubuntu-24.04-arm, target: linux-arm64 }
          - { os: macos-latest, target: darwin-arm64 }
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: built-files
          path: dist/
      - name: Make the binary executable
        run: chmod +x "dist/pantheon-scaffold-${{ matrix.target }}"
      - name: Run the smoke suite against the built binary
        run: mise x -- bun runner/scripts/smoke.ts "dist/pantheon-scaffold-${{ matrix.target }}" --version "$VERSION"

  release:
    name: Attest and publish
    needs: [prepare, smoke]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the pinned tools from the lock file
        run: mise install --locked
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: built-files
          path: dist/
      - name: Write checksums.txt after cross-checking the package files
        run: |
          rm -f dist/checksums.txt
          mise x -- bun runner/scripts/release-assets.ts checksums dist "$VERSION"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-assets
          path: dist/
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: error
      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        with:
          subject-path: |
            dist/pantheon-scaffold-*
            dist/pantheon-scaffold@*
            dist/checksums.txt
      - name: Publish the pre-release
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          gh release create "$TAG" dist/* \
            --verify-tag \
            --prerelease \
            --title "$TAG (pre-release)" \
            --notes "Pre-release of the package and the runner, released together. checksums.txt lists every file and carries a build provenance attestation: gh attestation verify checksums.txt --repo $GH_REPO"

  verify-release:
    name: Verify the published release on ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: [prepare, release]
    if: github.event_name == 'push'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm, macos-latest]
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
      TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
      REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
    steps:
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@9b200bcecbfd6303e69a4a261b2e09e3757440a7 # v5.2.0
        with:
          version: 2026.10.25
          install: false
          cache: false
      - name: Install the runner as a consumer would, with checksums and provenance enforced
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer" && cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer"
          cat > mise.toml <<TOML
          [settings]
          lockfile = true
          locked_verify_provenance = true
          lockfile_platforms = ["linux-x64", "linux-arm64", "macos-arm64"]

          [tools]
          pkl = "0.32.2"
          "github:$REPO" = "$VERSION"
          TOML
          mise lock
          # With no platform list mise locks every platform and picks the package zip for the ones with no runner, so the lock is checked.
          urls="$(grep -A6 "^\[tools\.\"github:$REPO\"\.\"platforms\." mise.lock | grep '^url = ' || true)"
          echo "$urls"
          test "$(echo "$urls" | grep -c .)" = 3
          if echo "$urls" | grep -vE '/pantheon-scaffold-(linux-x64|linux-arm64|darwin-arm64)"$'; then
            echo "mise chose an asset that is not a runner binary" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          mise install --locked
          test "$(mise x -- pantheon-scaffold --version)" = "$VERSION"
      - name: Verify the attestation of checksums.txt, as upgrade does
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer"
          curl -fsSL --retry 8 --retry-delay 10 --retry-all-errors -o checksums.txt "https://github.com/$REPO/releases/download/$TAG/checksums.txt"
          gh attestation verify checksums.txt --repo "$REPO"
      - name: Load the package from its package URI with the published checksum
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer"
          sum="$(awk -v n="pantheon-scaffold@$VERSION" '$2 == n { print $1 }' checksums.txt)"
          test -n "$sum"
          printf 'amends "package://github.com/%s/releases/download/%s/pantheon-scaffold@%s::sha256:%s#/Config.pkl"\n\noptions { toolchain = "1.96.1" }\n' "$REPO" "$TAG" "$VERSION" "$sum" > pantheon.pkl
          mise x -- pantheon-scaffold render pantheon.pkl --attempts 8
          mise x -- pantheon-scaffold check pantheon.pkl --attempts 8
      - name: Render the standard workflows and files through the package, check them, and render again
        run: |
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer"
          sum="$(awk -v n="pantheon-scaffold@$VERSION" '$2 == n { print $1 }' checksums.txt)"
          uri="package://github.com/$REPO/releases/download/$TAG/pantheon-scaffold@$VERSION::sha256:$sum"
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/standard"
          printf 'amends "%s#/Config.pkl"\nimport "%s#/Builtins.pkl"\n\noptions { toolchain = "1.96.1"; skillName = "demo-skill"; crateName = "demo" }\nworkflows { ...Builtins.standardWorkflows(options) }\nfiles { ...Builtins.standardFiles(options) }\n' "$uri" "$uri" > standard.pkl
          mise x -- pantheon-scaffold render standard.pkl --root "$RUNNER_TEMP/standard" --attempts 8
          mise x -- pantheon-scaffold check standard.pkl --root "$RUNNER_TEMP/standard" --attempts 8
          mise x -- pantheon-scaffold render standard.pkl --root "$RUNNER_TEMP/standard" --attempts 8 | tee again.txt
          grep -q "written 0 file(s)" again.txt
          for f in .github/workflows/dist-check.yml .github/workflows/audit-skill.yml .github/workflows/scaffold-check.yml dist-workspace.toml; do test -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/standard/$f"; done
          test ! -e "$RUNNER_TEMP/standard/.github/workflows/release.yml"
      - name: Dry-run upgrade against the real release
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/old"
          zeros="$(printf '0%.0s' $(seq 64))"
          printf 'amends "package://github.com/%s/releases/download/v0.0.0/pantheon-scaffold@0.0.0::sha256:%s#/Config.pkl"\n' "$REPO" "$zeros" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/old/pantheon.pkl"
          printf '[tools]\n"github:%s" = "0.0.0"\n' "$REPO" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/old/mise.toml"
          cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/consumer"
          mise x -- pantheon-scaffold upgrade "$VERSION" --dry-run --root "$RUNNER_TEMP/olZ"

# then records the date of the last successful check on the `freshness` branch. A failed check writes neither, so a failing check never reads as fresh.

    - cron: "23 4 * * 1"
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/update-pins.yml
      - runner/scripts/update-pins.ts
      - runner/src/pinupdate.ts

permissions: {}

  group: update-pins
  cancel-in-progress: false

  MISE_DISABLE_TOOLS: rust

  update:
    name: Update the pins
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

      contents: read

        run: mise install --locked
      - name: Check every pin and rewrite the ones that moved
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
        run: |
          mise x -- bun runner/scripts/update-pins.ts \
            --freshness-out "$RUNNER_TEMP/freshness.json" --summary "$RUNNER_TEMP/summary.md"

# Lints the bundled skill with agnix (https://github.com/agent-sh/agnix) against
# Claude Code's documented formats: frontmatter fields and values, allowed-tools
# names, broken links and leaked tool-call markup. The skill validator and auditor
# do not check these.
#
# Runs on every pull request and every push to main. A pull request fails only on
# an error it introduces, meaning an error whose rule and file are not already an
# error on the base branch (.github/scripts/agnix-introduced-errors.sh). Errors
# already on main and warnings show as annotations and never fail. Configuration
# lives in .agnix.toml. Never runs --fix.
#
# Ported from pantheon-org/tekhne. Issues: one per error (rule and file) and one per
# warning rule listing every affected file (.github/scripts/agnix-file-issues.sh). A
# pull request opens a missing issue but never edits or closes one; the run on main
# opens missing issues, refreshes warning file lists and closes issues whose finding
# is gone. One "## agnix" pull request comment shows PASS or FAIL and is updated in
# place on each run.
#
# No third-party action for agnix itself: the pinned release is downloaded from its
# public URL and checked against a pinned SHA-256 before it runs. The digest was
# taken from a tarball whose GitHub build attestation verified against agnix's
# release.yml.
name: agnix
'on':
  pull_request:
    types:
    - opened
    - synchronize
    - reopened
    branches:
    - main
  push:
    branches:
    - main
permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
env:
  AGNIX_VERSION: 0.56.6
  AGNIX_SHA256: 3228e88286c44da93bd591cc6358549c4a3d685b44c9d64625955d668528a155
jobs:
  agnix:
    name: agnix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork == false
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Check out the base branch
      uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      with:
        ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        path: base
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Install agnix (pinned digest)
      run: |
        set -euo pipefail
        asset="agnix-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz"
        dir="$RUNNER_TEMP/agnix"
        mkdir -p "$dir"
        curl -fsSL -o "$dir/$asset" \
          "https://github.com/agent-sh/agnix/releases/download/v${AGNIX_VERSION}/${asset}"
        echo "${AGNIX_SHA256}  $dir/$asset" | sha256sum -c -
        tar -xzf "$dir/$asset" -C "$dir"
        echo "$dir" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
    - name: Lint
      run: |
        agnix --version
        agnix -c .agnix.toml --format github . || true
        agnix -c .agnix.toml --format json . > agnix.json || true
    - name: Lint the base branch
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      run: |
        (cd base && agnix -c ../.agnix.toml --format json . > ../agnix-base.json) || true
    - name: File issues for findings
      continue-on-error: true
      run: bash .github/scripts/agnix-file-issues.sh agnix.json
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        MODE: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && 'main' || 'pr' }}
        PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        TRACKED_FILE: tracked-issues.md
    - name: Find errors this pull request introduces
      id: gate
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      continue-on-error: true
      run: bash .github/scripts/agnix-introduced-errors.sh agnix.json agnix-base.json
      env:
        INTRODUCED_FILE: introduced-errors.txt
    - name: Assemble comment
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      run: bash .github/scripts/agnix-assemble-comment.sh
    - name: Find existing agnix comment
      id: find-comment
      uses: peter-evans/find-comment@b30e6a3c0ed37e7c023ccd3f1db5c6c0b0c23aad
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      continue-on-error: true
      with:
        issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        comment-author: github-actions[bot]
        body-includes: '## agnix'
    - name: Post or update agnix comment
      uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@e8674b075228eee787fea43ef493e45ece1004c9
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
      continue-on-error: true
      with:
        comment-id: ${{ steps.find-comment.outputs.comment-id }}
        issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
        edit-mode: replace
        body-path: comment.md
    - name: Fail on introduced errors
      if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && steps.gate.outcome == 'failure'
      run: |
        echo "::error::This pull request introduces agnix errors; see the agnix comment."
        exiZ 1

# everything else is visible in Code Scanning and never blocks. The Plumber action
# runs with soft-fail + continue-on-error so its own A-E score gate and any
# transient runtime error never block; the ONLY blocking signal is a Critical

    - main

  contents: read

  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

  plumber:

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

# zizmor rule configuration for the zizmor workflow (.github/workflows/zizmor.yml).
#
# Every entry is a finding that existed when the gate was added and is
# deliberately not fixed. The default answer to a zizmor finding is to fix the
# workflow; an entry here needs a reason, and should be as narrow as the tool
# allows so it cannot hide anything else.
#
# All four entries are in .github/workflows/release.yml, which cargo-dist
# generates and overwrites on `dist generate`. Entries match on file, line and
# column, so a regenerated file that moves a line makes the finding reappear and
# fails the gate. When that happens, run the command in the workflow header,
# check the finding is still the same one, and update the line and column here.
# Do not edit release.yml by hand to avoid it: dist would undo the edit.

rules:
  excessive-permissions:
    ignore:
      # The workflow-level `contents: write` is what dist emits, so the release
      # job can create the GitHub release and upload artifacts. The workflow
      # runs only on a pushed version tag (pr-run-mode = "skip" in
      # dist-workspace.toml).
      - release.yml:18:3
  template-injection:
    ignore:
      # The `dist` plan step expands `github.ref_name` into its command. The
      # workflow runs only on a pushed version tag, and tags are created by
      # maintainers, not by a pull request.
      - release.yml:79:91
  unpinned-images:
    ignore:
      # The build matrix is produced by dist's plan job. The container image
      # comes from dist's own output, not from a pull request.
      - release.yml:110:40
      - release.ymZ:110:66
